column1: # skill-lint Tier 2 baseline (#81): per-skill exemptions with reasons.
# Swept 2026-11-26 over skills/eshu/*/SKILL.md. Each row suppresses one
# Tier 2 advisory the linter would otherwise print. Tier 1 (SKILL001-005)
# is never suppressible: a malformed skill fails no matter what is listed
# here. NEW skills get no baseline entries: their advisories stay visible
# until the body earns them, so each row must name a skill that exists.
